content_text:
Value Type Field
        A value type identifies how an accessorial 
 choice will appear on the Accessorial Assignment Window. 
         
        The following are the value types that you can assign on the Accessorial Header Window:
        
            
                
                
                
                    
                        Address
                        
                         
                         
                    
                    
                        Indicates  that the accessorial detail represents an address value. Using the Parent Field, you can associate other accessorial details (such as address lines, city, postal code, etc.) to a single "parent" address detail. See the Parent Field topic for more information.
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        Alpha
                        
                         
                    
                    
                        Indicates that the accessorial detail is an alphabetical value. 
 This value type is usually reserved for special instructions. 
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        Checkbox
                        
                         
                    
                    
                        Indicates that the accessorial detail displays a checkbox which 
 the user can select or deselect. This is commonly used for accessorial 
 services which are optional, such as Saturday Delivery. 
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        Complex
                        
                         
                    
                    
                        Indicates that the accessorial detail has a complex structure.
                         
                    
                
                
                    
                        Numeric
                        
                         
                    
                    
                        Indicates that the accessorial detail is a numeric value. This value 
 type identifies the monetary amount levied to cover the accessorial task.
